scientific_integrity: The risk difference is derived analytically from beta-gamma factorization and an exact incomplete-beta simplification. The unique crossover follows from a monotonicity argument and explicit endpoint signs. Numerical calculations are used only to replay the formula and print threshold values.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares only the MLE and the BSEE analogue for two exponential populations with a common sample size under entropy loss. It does not claim either estimator is globally admissible, and it does not cover three or more populations. An equivalent older calculation under a reciprocal scale parametrization remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: Exact risk phase diagram for two natural selected-hazard estimators
